spec.scene: Devon asks the user to get pizza Friday after work.
facts: Devon and the user agree to Friday pizza at 7 pm at Rosa's on Oak Street.

dialogue: Devon: finally home ugh
Me: same, just kicked my shoes off
Devon: that meeting today went forever again
Me: oh no same team as yesterday?
Devon: yeah they won't drop this Saturday lunch thing
Me: the Domino's at 2 thing?
Devon: yep still trying to get me to go
Me: you still passing on it?
Devon: oh yeah hard pass, helping my mom anyway
Me: good, how'd that chicken turn out last night btw
Devon: wait that was you with the chicken lol mine was cereal
Me: oh right lol mine was actually pretty good
Devon: lemon pepper right?
Me: yeah had leftovers for lunch today
Devon: nice, I had sad desk salad
Me: ugh hate those
Devon: so random but wanna grab pizza Friday after work?
Me: oh like actual good pizza not Domino's lol
Devon: lol exactly, need to wash that thought out of my brain
Me: I'm down, where you thinking?
Devon: what about Rosa's on Oak Street?
Me: ohh I haven't been there in ages
Devon: me neither, been craving their crust
Me: yes their crust is so good
Devon: you good with like 7 Friday?
Me: yeah that works for me
Devon: perfect, I can head straight after work
Me: me too, hopefully 5th isn't still a mess
Devon: oh it's Rosa's so we avoid 5th anyway
Me: true, Oak is way easier for me
Devon: did you ever get stuck going that way Thursday? you said you had to?
Me: yeah I left early like you said, still slow by the bank
Devon: that construction is never ending
Me: fr, did you ever do that autopay thing?
Devon: ugh I started it last night then got distracted
Me: lol classic, just finish it tonight
Devon: I will, no more late fees
Me: my mom called today btw
Devon: oh yeah? everything good?
Me: yeah just complaining about her dryer
Devon: lol my dryer still has that load from last week I think
Me: no way you still haven't folded it?
Devon: I folded like half and gave up
Me: relatable, did your mom get her groceries done?
Devon: we're doing that Saturday afternoon still
Me: tell her I said hi again
Devon: will do, she still owes you potato salad lol
Me: omg don't remind me I'm hungry now
Devon: lol save room for Friday
Me: oh for sure, 7 can't come fast enough
Devon: you want to just meet there?
Me: yeah easier, I'll text when I'm close
Devon: cool I'll try to grab a table
Me: sounds good, I'm gonna go reheat this chicken
cost_note: API did not report a charge
